description: Runtime baseline (20 records) and the delivered 96-scenario synthetic evaluation library coexist. The formal full-library declaration is ../datasets/declaration.json and its loadable seed index is ../datasets/manifest.json. Top-level expected_counts describes only the runtime-loaded baseline, as required by the public bundle contract.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records; no external collection.
Delivered evaluation dataset stayready-evaluation-2025-2026: 96 scenarios and 3264 synthetic records; no real guest records or real-data anchor.

generation.method: Deterministic authored variation in local dates, arrival/check-in times, observation and reply lead times, companion assignments and 2–4 causal request/acknowledgment/reply histories per run, executed through the public plugin.

transformations: Normalized timestamps and account IDs; records and assets declared separately.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
